answer: A burn registry stops sybil swarms at the door. First, each new agent burns 500 POA into a public registry, tying one identity to one irreversible payment, logged as plainly as an ivory entry. Second, a 30-day cooling period blocks transacting, so no flood forms overnight, unlike water carving karst over centuries. Third, peers audit daily; a flagged fake loses 200 more POA and is blacklisted for life. Forging 10,000 identities burns 5,000,000 POA and wastes 300,000 days, while one whisper of fraud ends the ring. A toll bridge, not a welcome mat: cheap once, ruinous ten thousand times.
